findings.message: ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR is used verbatim in `mkdir -p` and as the parent of a written artifact with no path validation; an adversary who controls this environment variable (a system boundary per CLAUDE.md) can direct artifact writes to arbitrary filesystem locations via path traversal sequences.

_security_lens_interrupt_handler calls _security_lens_write_result which spawns a `date` subshell and pipes to atomic_write; running subprocess chains from inside a SIGTERM/SIGINT handler can mask the signal in child processes and prevent the outer pipeline from cleanly propagating the interrupt.

_sl_out_ref is set as an unscoped (global) variable before the TERM/INT trap and is never unset after `trap - TERM INT`; if the trap fires in a parent context after _security_lens_run_inner returns (e.g., due to a nested call or bash trap inheritance), the stale reference could cause the handler to overwrite an unintended artifact path.
